business_problem: MISO is a regional transmission operator thatneeded a new data platform to manage, hedge against, and respond to market risks and opportunities as well as meet future energy demand to manage uncertainty and long-term planning.
solution_summary: MISO used Microsoft Dynamics 365, Power BI, Microsoft Purview to unify data and reporting on a shared analytics foundation. MISO is a regional transmission operator thatneeded a new data platform to manage, hedge against, and respond to market risks and opportunities as well as meet future energy demand to manage uncertainty and long-term planning. Key implementation elements included Microsoft Dynamics 365 provides the common business process layer that standardizes operations; Power BI delivers reports and dashboards to business users; Microsoft Purview adds governance and compliance controls to the data estate; Microsoft Azure hosts the application, data, and integrations on scalable cloud infrastructure. Operational data is ingested from line-of-business systems into the shared data platform, transformed into analytics-ready models, and served to analysts and business users through dashboards and reporting experiences.
